source_observation.summary: A separate 4mm small pin/receiver trial was difficult to handle and some holes were reported blocked by plastic. The cause, actual sliced input and successful correction values were not established.
source_observation.reuse_boundary: Observations only. No source photographs, videos, geometry, private history or model license is copied or transferred.

stages.gate: Use the existing male/female and NP3 keyway trials first; do not print every clearance candidate together.
Print only the two 2x2 and two 2x4 blocks; stop for obstruction, handling difficulty, failed seating or damage.
After the real-block gate passes, print one keeper and two identical left-end base blocks for ONE selected variant.
Only after these screens pass, test the selected real five-course base, its own full-size message/logo and all three keepers before the face.

not_qualified: Actual handling, open cavities, seating or clutch before printing
Complete five-course alignment, full-width module capture or three-keeper retention
Long-part warping, strength, tip resistance, print time or mass
Commercial compatibility guarantee, toy safety or manufacturing certification
